title: Run metadata
description: Auto-captured reproducibility metadata for one experiment run. Never hand-written. Closes the field's under-reporting gap (Frontier Lag; benchmark self-audit 0.38/1.0) by making the under-reported fields mandatory and automatic.

acceptance.description: What done means for this run: what must be true before it can honestly be called finished. Written when the run is filed and never edited afterwards. Prefer a condition a script could evaluate.

git_sha.description: Commit SHA of the analysis/code repo at run creation. Anchors reproducibility.

models.description: Every model used in the run, one entry per (model, role).

id.description: Exact model ID as requested, e.g. claude-opus-4-8.

served_id.description: The model ID the response reports, recorded beside the requested `id` (a provider may route a request to another model and still answer HTTP 200). `publish` flags a missing one and blocks when it differs from `id`.

role.description: What this model did in the pipeline. A `judge`, `reviewer` or `grader` is an instrument: one whose id differs between runs compared in one analysis is flagged.

compute.description: Where the job ran. MATS compute is heterogeneous and mostly ephemeral, so this is often a rented box that no longer exists — hence provider + ephemeral flag.

cost.description: Cost reporting is universally absent in the field (benchmark self-audit). Capturing it is a differentiator.

prereg.description: Link to the pre-registration's two commitment points, so metadata alone proves each commitment existed: `hypothesis` (hypothesis, prediction, falsifier; frozen before the pilot) and `design` (metric, decision rule, method, confounds, guards; frozen after it).

stage_status.description: Per-stage lifecycle, keyed by the eleven research stages of the MATS dashboard's Automated Alignment tool, in its order. Lets any tool resume the run and lets the PI review surface show progress.

unachievable.description: Proposals to close the run as `unachievable`: the sanctioned way to say it cannot be done, with a required reason. The agent proposes; the researcher accepts (closing the run: an honest end state, not a pass, and not a silent stop) or reopens it. An unreviewed proposal is not a closed state. Every proposal stays on the record; at most one awaits review.

reason.description: "X is unavailable / cannot be done because…"

decision.description: null while awaiting the researcher's review.

content_hash.description: sha256:... of that commitment point's fields at freeze time.
